system.name: npd-loader
system.description: Downloads the CMS National Provider Directory FHIR bulk release, flattens it in Python into 26 tables, merges each release into one current dataset in SQL Server by per-resource hash, and records every run and file in the warehouse catalog

people.name: Data engineer / operator
people.description: Runs init-db, import --force, status and profile by hand; installs and schedules the loader

people.name: Analyst / downstream jobs
people.description: Query the current merged npd tables and v_* views

containers.name: npd-loader CLI
containers.technology: Python 3.12, Python-DataEngine (SQLAlchemy + pyodbc), orjson, bcp.exe, httpx, zstandard
containers.description: Stages download -> extract -> import (Python flatten, bcp into staging, one-transaction delta apply, .ndjson retention); commands run, download, extract, import, status, init-db, profile

containers.name: npd database
containers.description: npd.resource_state (surrogate int key registry with per-resource hash and last seen release), 26 key-shaped npd.* tables holding the current merged dataset, npd.resource_type, npd.release, v_* views; npd_stage.* fixed text-shaped staging tables

containers.name: Warehouse catalog
containers.description: Shared run and file tracking: dbo.MASTER_WAREHOUSE_RUN (one row per DOWNLOAD/EXTRACT/IMPORT run) and dbo.DATA_FILE (manifest, .zst, .ndjson files)

containers.name: Release file store
containers.technology: Local disk (storage backend 'local', e.g. D:\npd or E:\npd_dev_data)
containers.description: Run folders holding the manifest, downloaded .ndjson.zst files (the backup of every release) and extracted .ndjson files, plus transient stage/run_<id> bcp files during an import

external_systems.name: CMS National Provider Directory downloads
external_systems.description: Publishes the weekly FHIR bulk release: manifest.json plus one .ndjson.zst per resource type, served through signed redirect URLs

external_systems.name: Windows Task Scheduler
external_systems.description: Starts `npd-loader run` daily through scripts/npd-loader-run.cmd, which appends the log

relationships.description: Fetches manifest and release files from
Writes .zst and .ndjson files to, reads them back for import
bcp-loads staging, applies the release delta in one transaction
Records runs and data files in
Queries the current merged npd tables and v_* views

npd-loader.npd_loader.cli: Entry point: parses commands, builds the stage Context (dialect, catalog, storage, HTTP client), maps outcomes to exit codes
npd-loader.npd_loader.config: Parses config.toml into typed sections (npd_db schema/stage_schema, worker counts, lock timeout); rejects legacy host/user/password keys
npd-loader.npd_loader.connections: Reads the DataEngine database.env and builds the SqlConnectionObject by name (the data connection must be mssql)
npd-loader.npd_loader.stages: Shared stage plumbing: Context, run lock, run folders, failure recording, closing interrupted runs
npd-loader.npd_loader.download: DOWNLOAD stage: manifest, signed-URL fetch with retries, sha256, data_file rows
npd-loader.npd_loader.manifest: Parses manifest.json and maps file names to FHIR resource types
npd-loader.npd_loader.extract: EXTRACT stage: .zst -> .ndjson, restores deleted files in place
npd-loader.npd_loader.import_stage: IMPORT stage: finds inputs (extracting if needed), refuses older releases without --force, stage_release -> apply_delta, .ndjson retention, catalog bookkeeping
npd-loader.npd_loader.raw_load: Engine-neutral import input: the .ndjson file descriptor and the line reader/validator
npd-loader.npd_loader.dialect: MssqlDialect: init-db, truncate/stage_release (flatten + parallel bcp + row-count and duplicate checks), apply_delta (classify new/changed/unchanged/not seen by hash, assign surrogate keys, delete+insert changed resources, one locked transaction), run lock; bcp.py wraps bcp.exe
npd-loader.npd_loader.sqltext: SQL token rendering, GO batch splitting and the packaged init SQL scripts
npd-loader.npd_loader.retention: Keeps the .ndjson files of the newest keep_releases releases and deletes older ones; never touches data, .zst files or catalog rows
npd-loader.npd_loader.catalog: SqlCatalog on SQLAlchemy Core over MASTER_WAREHOUSE_RUN / DATA_FILE (both engines)
npd-loader.npd_loader.runxml: Builds xml_config / xml_output for catalog runs
npd-loader.npd_loader.storage: LocalStorage: atomic writes, reads, sizes and deletes under the storage root
npd-loader.npd_loader.profile: `profile` command: lists JSON paths in a release file and flags unmapped ones
npd-loader.npd_loader.flatten: Declarative table specs (specs.py, SPEC_VERSION), the generic flattener (engine.py), value converters and reference parsing (convert.py), and parallel per-file workers writing 0x1F/0x1E bcp files plus one hash row per resource (stagefiles.py; SHA-1 without meta.lastUpdated)

flows.name: Scheduled daily run (download, extract, import)
flows.description: From Task Scheduler to a merged release; the import extracts first if .ndjson files are missing.

steps.description: GET manifest.json, then each .ndjson.zst via signed URL
flatten_files: one worker per .ndjson (flatten_workers), rows + hash rows to bcp files
TRUNCATE npd_stage.*, bcp in (bcp_workers parallel), check row counts and duplicate ids
Classify by hash and merge in one transaction (see delta-apply flow)
IMPORT run Success + per-table row counts; DATE_LOADED on .ndjson rows

flows.name: Delta apply of a release (SQL Server)
flows.description: The staged release is merged into the current dataset; only new and changed resources are rewritten.

steps.description: Build npd_stage.delta: join resource_hash with resource_state; kind N (no hash yet), C (hash differs), U (same)
SET XACT_ABORT, LOCK_TIMEOUT; BEGIN TRAN (retry the whole transaction on lock timeout 1222)
INSERT resource_state rows for new ids (IDENTITY keys) and for referenced-only ids from N/C rows
Per table: DELETE rows of changed resources by resource_key; INSERT N/C rows translating text ids to keys
UPDATE resource_state (hash, last_updated for N/C; last_seen for all seen); MERGE npd.release; COMMIT
Readers see the merged release (READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT: old version until COMMIT)
steps.note: assumption: consumers read the npd tables or v_* views
